title: What Is a Safety Plan?
learning_goal: Understand the purpose of a safety plan and how it reduces risk during DFV situations.

content.micro_lesson: A safety plan is a personalised, practical plan that outlines steps to increase safety during escalating conflict, separation, or emergencies. It includes safe contacts, escape routes, code words, essential documents, and technology safety.
content.activity: Complete the safety plan template with at least five personalised safety actions.
content.caseworker_flags: Learner reports no safe contacts or no access to essential documents.
content.escalation_trigger: Learner indicates immediate danger or inability to leave safely.

title: Identifying Risk
learning_goal: Recognise key DFV risk indicators and understand how risk escalates.

content.micro_lesson: Risk indicators include threats, stalking, strangulation, pregnancy, separation, access to weapons, and escalating jealousy. Risk is dynamic and can change quickly.
content.activity: Complete a risk‑indicator checklist based on a fictional scenario.
content.caseworker_flags: Any disclosure of weapons, strangulation, or threats to kill.
content.escalation_trigger: Presence of high‑risk indicators triggers immediate MARAC/IDVA pathway.

title: High‑Risk Indicators
learning_goal: Identify high‑risk DFV factors that require urgent intervention.

content.micro_lesson: High‑risk factors include strangulation, threats to kill, stalking, sexual violence, pregnancy, recent separation, and obsessive jealousy. These factors significantly increase the likelihood of serious harm.
content.activity: Analyse a case study and highlight all high‑risk indicators.
content.caseworker_flags: Any admission of strangulation or threats to kill.
content.escalation_trigger: Strangulation or threats to kill require immediate high‑risk response.

title: Emergency Planning
learning_goal: Create an emergency plan for rapid exit during DFV escalation.

content.micro_lesson: Emergency planning includes identifying exits, preparing a go‑bag, rehearsing escape routes, establishing code words, and knowing safe locations. Planning increases survival in high‑risk situations.
content.caseworker_flags: Learner reports no safe exit routes or no access to transportation.
content.escalation_trigger: Learner indicates imminent risk or inability to escape safely.

title: Technology Safety
learning_goal: Understand how technology can be used for harm and how to stay safe online.

content.micro_lesson: Technology‑enabled abuse includes tracking devices, spyware, account access, location sharing, and monitoring messages. Safety steps include password resets, two‑factor authentication, checking devices, and reviewing app permissions.
content.activity: Complete a tech‑safety audit using the provided checklist.
content.caseworker_flags: Evidence of spyware, tracking, or unauthorised account access.
content.escalation_trigger: Active surveillance or stalking triggers immediate tech‑safety intervention.

title: Safety With Children
learning_goal: Learn how to create safety plans that include children during DFV incidents.

content.micro_lesson: Children need simple, rehearsed safety steps: safe rooms, code words, emergency contacts, and knowing not to intervene. Safety plans must be age‑appropriate and trauma‑informed.
content.activity: Create a child‑inclusive safety plan using the template.
content.caseworker_flags: Child expresses fear of a parent or unsafe home environment.
content.escalation_trigger: Any child‑related risk triggers mandatory child protection referral.

title: Caseworker Evidence Upload
learning_goal: Compile and submit safety‑related evidence for caseworker review.

content.micro_lesson: This lesson consolidates all Week 3 safety planning materials. Learners upload finalised safety plans, risk checklists, and emergency plans for caseworker review.
content.evidence_required: Safety plan, risk checklist, emergency plan, tech‑safety audit.
content.caseworker_flags: Missing safety plan or incomplete high‑risk documentation.
content.escalation_trigger: Any high‑risk indicator found in uploads triggers immediate triage.
